items.title: Base change in degree q descends along an integral base change of the target
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that an isomorphism of the base change map in degree q for a quasi-compact quasi-separated g' descends from a composite situation to the intermediate one when the intervening morphism pi is integral (statement lines 16996-17031). The proof (proof lines 17033-17043) replaces the derived pushforwards along the integral morphisms by ordinary ones, rewrites both sides through the base change identity, and applies the hypothesis together with the integrality lemma. H2: one rewriting plus one application.
